title: Themes
description: DataViews grid + table view of installed themes. Reads via `core-data` `'root','theme'` entity.

variant.description: Optional DataView variant id. v2 back-compat: when the v3 compiler synthesizes a screen from a v2 route, `config.variant` stays on `screen.config.variant` and the resolver's step-3 manifest-inference path reads it directly to reach `settings.dataViews.root.theme.<variant>`.

documentation.purpose: DataViews host over the `root/theme` entity. Default grid layout shows screenshot + name + status + truncated description; table layout offers sortable columns for power users. The Activate action (eligible only when status=inactive) calls the workspace's custom `/wp-admin-workspaces/v1/activate-theme` endpoint (gated on `switch_themes`); on failure it surfaces an error snackbar. The Details action opens a modal with full description + version + author + theme-site link, plus (for child themes) a "This is a child theme of {parent}" line, the theme's tags, and a Live Preview / Customize link (block themes → Site Editor, classic → Customizer) for inactive themes.

reads.purpose: Resolved DataView doc — fields, default view, default layouts, actions. Read via `useDataView(screenId)`; baseline ships in `app.json#dataView` and is injected post-merge by `inject_app_baselines`.

writes.purpose: Switch the active theme via the workspace's custom endpoint.

states.renders: DataViews built-in loading indicator over an empty grid.
Grid layout with screenshot tiles; status='active' floats first via the default sort by status asc. Activate action surfaces as an icon button on non-active rows; Details opens a modal.

states.when: User clicked Details on a row
states.renders: DataViews RenderModal with large screenshot + full description + version / author + (child themes) parent-theme line + tags + Theme site / Live Preview / Activate buttons.

interactions.effect: POST `/wp-admin-workspaces/v1/activate-theme` with `{ stylesheet }`; on success invalidate `root/theme` and show a success snackbar. On failure show an error snackbar with the decoded WP_Error message.
Open the details modal with that theme's metadata + inline Activate button + Theme site link.
Navigate via `<a href>` to the Customizer preview (`customize.php?theme={slug}`) — routed through the kernel admin-link interceptor.

a11y.focus-management: DataViews owns focus inside the grid + modal. The RenderModal contract restores focus to the action trigger on close.

constraints.note: WordPress core REST does not expose a theme-switch operation (upstream parity #143). The workspace ships a custom `/wp-admin-workspaces/v1/activate-theme` endpoint (`WP_Admin_Workspaces_Themes_REST`, gated on `switch_themes`, validates the stylesheet via `wp_get_theme()` then calls `switch_theme()`); rebuilds must provide the equivalent server-side hook.

If the endpoint rejects (missing/broken/incompatible/disallowed theme, insufficient caps), the app shows an error snackbar with the decoded WP_Error message rather than navigating away. `activate()` returns a success boolean so the details-modal Activate button only closes on success.

design-system-leakage.purpose: DataViews + DataForm components, field descriptor shape. Grid + table view with filtering, sorting, pagination, selection, per-row + bulk actions, action modals.
Details modal layout and action buttons.
Activate action icon (registered in the core-default engine icon table).
